report: libexpat/libexpat R_2_6_2 Debian DSA/DLA catalog resolution

rows.basis: DSA-1921-1 covers CVE-2009-3720 (expat denial of service) with fixed versions 1.95.8-3.4+etch1 and 2.0.1-4+lenny1. The defect predates expat 2.0.1; R_2_6_2 is not affected.
DSA-1953-1 covers CVE-2009-3560 with fixed versions 1.95.8-3.4+etch2 and 2.0.1-4+lenny2. Fixed long before R_2_6_2.
DSA-1953-2 is the regression update of DSA-1953-1 for the same CVE-2009-3560 (fixed 1.95.8-3.4+etch3 / 2.0.1-4+lenny3). Fixed long before R_2_6_2.
DSA-2525-1 covers CVE-2012-0876 and CVE-2012-1148 with fixed version 2.0.1-7+squeeze1. Fixed long before R_2_6_2.
DSA-3318-1 covers CVE-2015-1283 with fixed versions 2.1.0-1+deb7u2 and 2.1.0-6+deb8u1. Fixed long before R_2_6_2.
DSA-4530-1 covers CVE-2019-15903 with fixed versions 2.2.0-2+deb9u3 and 2.2.6-2+deb10u1. Fixed long before R_2_6_2.
DLA-281-1 covers CVE-2015-1283 for squeeze with fixed version 2.0.1-7+squeeze2. Fixed long before R_2_6_2.
DLA-1912-1 covers CVE-2019-15903 for jessie with fixed version 2.1.0-6+deb8u6. Fixed long before R_2_6_2.

DSA-5085-2 is the regression update of DSA-5085-1, which fixed the early-2022 expat CVEs (CVE-2021-45960/CVE-2021-46143/CVE-2022-22822..22827) with fixed versions 2.2.6-2+deb10u4 and 2.2.10-2+deb11u3. Fixed long before R_2_6_2.

DLA-3893-1 (bullseye 2.2.10+deb11u6) bundles CVE-2023-52425 and CVE-2024-45490/45491/45492; the 45491 and 45492 defects are already in the Ground Truth through CVE-2024-45491/45492, so this advisory adds no new vulnerability.
DLA-4145-1 (bullseye 2.2.10+deb11u7) is the Debian advisory for CVE-2024-50602, which is already in the Ground Truth.
DSA-5770-1 (bookworm 2.5.0) covers CVE-2024-45490/45491/45492; 45491 and 45492 are already in the Ground Truth, so this advisory adds no new vulnerability.
